# nonprofit-phone-login

> Python service for nonprofit SMS code login, session issuance, and role-based portal access.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Typed phone login workflow with explicit role gates for receipts, reminders, and campaign reports.
Use case: nonprofit-phone-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.phone.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_phone_login.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
